title: Day 686 — Sheinbaum Reports 60% Jump in Specialist Consultations, 32 New Hospitals Toward Universal Health System
detail: On August 18, 2026 (Day 686, Tuesday), President Sheinbaum presented healthcare-system figures at her mañanera: specialist consultations rose 60% between Jan–Jul 2022 and the same period of 2026; IMSS reported 64.9 million family-medicine consultations, 19.7 million specialty consultations, and 1.1 million surgeries; IMSS-Bienestar logged 4 million consultations in July 2026 alone, its highest month yet, with a goal of 100 million annual consultations by 2030; and ISSSTE said it exceeded its 2025 surgical target (308,579 vs. 300,000 planned), with consultations climbing from 12.96 million (2024) to 15.29 million (Jan–Jul 2026). She said 32 specialty hospitals are now operating, with 39 targeted by year-end, and that new electronic health records should cut specialist wait times.

media.caption: Sheinbaum presents healthcare-system consultation and hospital-expansion figures

title: Day 686 — Gasoline Shortage in CDMX, Chiapas, Nuevo León Resolved; 1 Million Women Register for Pensión Bienestar
detail: On August 18, 2026 (Day 686, Tuesday), President Sheinbaum said a gasoline supply shortage affecting Mexico City, Chiapas, and Nuevo León had been resolved, calling it 'cosa de unos días.' Welfare Secretary Ariadna Montiel reported that more than 1 million women had registered for the Pensión Mujeres Bienestar program since applications opened August 1 for women aged 60 and above. Profeco director Iván Escalante presented the latest '¿Quién es Quién?' price-comparison balance tracking gasoline, groceries, and remittance-service pricing nationwide. Sheinbaum also addressed the ongoing visa revocation of Andy López Beltrán, denying his implication in the fuel-theft ('huachicol fiscal') probe and calling U.S. scrutiny of him politically motivated, and said she would meet Morena's congressional coordinators Adán Augusto López and Ricardo Monreal that afternoon on legislative priorities.

media.caption: Sheinbaum announces the CDMX/Chiapas/Nuevo León gasoline shortage is resolved as Pensión Mujeres Bienestar registrations pass 1 million
